globalNotes: Icons: viewBox 0 0 24 24, no width/height, stroke=currentColor stroke-width=2 linecap/linejoin=round (solid glyphs use fill=currentColor). Tint with SvgPicture colorFilter or Icon(color:).
All icons are 2px Lucide-style line icons. Set Size at the call site; do not bake width/height into the file.

QA round 2 swept all 63 icons for name-vs-drawing agreement: 26 were redrawn because the extracted glyph showed something else (bin drew a briefcase, cafe a headset, saved a male symbol, washing_machine a minus circle), and ic_baking_bag was deleted as a duplicate of ic_bag. Render design/ICONS_OVERVIEW.png with `node tools/render-icon-sheet.mjs` to re-check the set at true 24px.

LAUNCHER ICON: app_icon.svg is a full-bleed square - no rounded corners, no outer stroke, opaque. iOS and Android apply their own masks, so never bake an rx or a transparency into it. Only app_icon_foreground.svg is transparent, because the adaptive-icon foreground must be.
app_icon.svg puts the Pip head at 62% of the canvas; app_icon_foreground.svg uses 66% because that is Android's guaranteed-visible safe area. The 4% delta is intentional - do not unify them.

AUTHORING MISMATCHES (screens, not assets): P10's quest rows are icon-shifted by one and K08's "Park cafe trip" card was authored with the lamp shape. Assets are now named by SUBJECT, not by the row they were authored into, so re-map dartName to the right quest when you build P10/K08 - do not read a mis-authored row as evidence the glyph is wrong.
Two distinct container glyphs, kept separate on purpose: ic_bin (UK wheelie bin, quest 'Put the bins out') and ic_basket (laundry basket with weave lines, P02/P04 tidy-hero).

Two 'shop' glyph sets exist between P14 and K08 (ic_film/ic_film_strip, ic_clock/ic_moon, ic_cafe/ic_lamp). They are distinct SUBJECTS, not duplicates - film player vs film strip, clock vs moon, coffee cup vs lamp. ic_baking_bag was deleted as a true duplicate of ic_bag; K08 baking now uses ic_chef_hat.
tokens.css has NO dark block. NestlingColorsDark in lib/theme/nestling_tokens.dart is derived, not authored - see its doc comment. It needs design sign-off before shipping dark mode.

RASTERS: every one of the 22 illustrations plus the 3 brand files has a raster target. rasterBox is the largest on-screen usage, so 1x is meaningful; emit 2x and 3x next to it. Every illustration also stays as an SVG, so nothing is lost if a raster is dropped.

assets.name: app_icon
assets.notes: Full 1024 launcher icon: FULL-BLEED square, no rx, no outer stroke, opaque #17804F edge to edge. iOS and Android apply their own masks, so rounded corners must not be baked in - they produced a double-rounded, outlined icon. Pip head occupies 62% of the canvas (635px) and is centred at (512,512) via translate(512 512) scale(0.83) translate(-510.5 -478); source art bbox is x[149,872] y[96,860]. Background was re-pointed from #1F9D63 (the old --success) to #17804F (--leaf) to match adaptive_icon_background. Rasterise to flutter/assets/brand/app_icon.png at 1024x1024 for flutter_launcher_icons.

assets.name: app_icon_foreground
assets.notes: Pip head only, transparent background, sized for the Android adaptive-icon safe zone: the inner 66% of 1024 (676px), via translate(512 512) scale(0.88) translate(-510 -478). Source art bbox x[149,872] y[96,860] scaled 0.88. Deliberately 66% rather than the 62% used in app_icon.svg - 66% is the Android guaranteed-visible area and is a platform constraint, not a style choice, so the composite icon and the adaptive foreground differ by 4%. Rasterise to app_icon_foreground.png (1024, keep alpha).

assets.name: app_icon_background
assets.notes: Solid #17804F full-bleed 1024 square, no rounding, opaque - iOS/Android apply their own mask. This is the same rect that fills app_icon.svg, so the two cannot drift. Must stay in sync with --leaf and NestlingColorsLight.leaf.
